'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Blake Huffman DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
